text:
jess: quick kickoff — we keep confusing customers by returning 503 for graceful fallbacks. need a machine-readable contract so SDKs + console can show 'degraded' without sounding like an outage. ideas?

mike: agree. operator confusion + support noise. don't repurpose 5xx. prefer a header + telemetry enum.

kai: +1. prefer keeping HTTP transport semantics: real failures 4xx/5xx. for handled but lower-fidelity responses, return 200 and add outcome header.

sarah: SDKs need typed exceptions/events, not string parsing. define canonical enums and map them to SDK classes.

olivia: console UX: show a small outcome badge on routes (green/yellow/red) and a hover with reason + % of traffic. also timeline for recent spikes.

raj: concrete: X-RW-Outcome: success|partial|degraded|failed|rate_limited and X-RW-Outcome-Reason: lower_model|fallback_timeout|quota_exceeded|circuit_breaker. add telemetry tag api.outcome.v1 with same canonical enums.

mike: add companion X-RW-Retry: none|client|server so clients know whether to retry. default none for partial/degraded.

kai: runtime note: emit header at edge for consistency; body-level rw_outcome field can be optional for clients that only parse JSON. strip detailed reason in logs for PII tenants.

sarah: SDK mapping suggestion: success -> normal; partial -> PartialOutcome event + wrapper; degraded -> DegradedWarning exception with outcome metadata; failed/rate_limited -> existing error classes.

olivia: console copy: "Degraded — traffic served by a lower-capacity model to preserve latency/SLOs." "Partial — some inputs returned lower-fidelity outputs." link to runbook.

jess: rollout: server emits headers + telemetry behind per-tenant feature flag. canary 5% day1, 25% day2, 100% day3. SDKs map enums next week, console badge after SDK release.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature/outcome-headers -> staging (adds edge header emission + api.outcome.v1) :rocket:

raj: i'll write an RFC with enum tables, SDK examples, and console mocks, assign to eng-platform + eng-runtime.

mike: testing: unit header tests, integration canary, smoke to verify 429/500 unchanged.

sarah: runbook: triage steps: 1) check api.outcome.v1 2) inspect outcome.reason 3) consult tenant toggle for fallback.

jess: consensus?

all: +1

jess: closing thread. will announce in #prod-notices once SDKs shipped.
